components.reason: The installed distribution has only legacy License: BSD metadata, no License-Expression, no License-File, and no installed license file. The exact PyPI source archive was additionally verified and contained no complete license text.

components.reason: CMake requests a static OpenSSL::Crypto target but fixes neither version nor OpenSSL root/source archive/hash. The cryptography wheel SBOM's OpenSSL 4.0.2 record is intentionally not reused for this independent CMake dependency.
